newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Enerco revenue up 13 percent in first qtr.
newsitem.headline: Enerco revenue up 13 percent in first qtr.

text.p: Gas distributor Enerco Corp Ltd said on Friday that revenue was up 13 percent and unaudited after-tax profit up 11 percent in the first three months of the 1997/98 year on the corresponding period of last year.
"The board of Enerco believes that increased profitability can be achieved in 1997-1998," chairman John Gray told shareholders at the annual meeting in Auckland.
Volume sales to business for the first quarter are were up 8 percent and to homes up 20 percent.
In the March 1997 year the net profit was $18.86 million.
Gray said all necessary consent had been received for the 31 kilometre pipeline from Henderson to Albany on the outskirts of Auckland with construction due to begin in October.
Network expansion of 150 km was planned for 1997-98, mainly in Auckland, and a home gas marketing campaign was under way.
Customer numbers had risen from 101,500 to 105,500 during the June quarter which suggested that the 10,000 target for the year is realistic, Gray said.

Seismic survey work in the North Island East Coast prospecting areas had given encouraging results. Enerco has set aside $2.7 million to continue oil and gas exploration work there, and in the South Wanganui Basin during the year.
